predecessors.name: Ottoman Empire
predecessors.text: Vlorë, 'the only town in the whole country under the delegates' control' on 28 November 1912; the rest of what became Albania was Ottoman land occupied by the Balkan League states

successors.name: People's Socialist Republic of Albania
successors.text: Albania within its 1913 borders, as the '2nd Republic of Albania' proclaimed 10 January 1946 (infobox)

rulers.name: Victor Emmanuel III of Italy
rulers.title: King, in personal union with Italy

ledger.x: 28 November 1912: the Assembly of Vlorë declares Albania independent.
July 1913: the Great Powers recognise Albania within borders they draw, the Balkan League armies having occupied the land.
21 February 1914: Albania becomes a principality.
October 1914: Greek forces enter southern Albania.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1916 (page silent on the date): Austro-Hungarian and Bulgarian forces occupy about two-thirds of Albania.
September 1918: the Austro-Hungarian forces leave Albania.
11 November 1918: Italy holds most of Albania.
November 1918: French forces hold Korçë and Shkodër.
November 1918: Serbia holds the northern mountains.
1920 (page silent on the date): Greek forces leave the south.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: 1920 (page silent on the date): French forces leave Korçë and Shkodër.
1920 (page silent on the date): Serbian troops leave the northern mountains.
January 1920: the Congress of Lushnjë makes Tirana the capital.
September 1920: Italy leaves Albania except Sazan.
31 January 1925: the principality becomes a republic.
1 September 1928: Zog makes Albania a kingdom.
7 April 1939: Italy invades Albania.
Spring 1941: Kosovo joins Albania under Italian auspices.
ledger.cpn: Kingdom of Yugoslavia (Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes)

ledger.x: September 1943: Italy capitulates and its occupation of Albania ends.
Autumn 1943: Germany occupies Albania.
1944 (page silent): Kosovo goes back to Yugoslavia.
29 November 1944: the partisans free all Albania.
10 January 1946: the People's Republic replaces the Democratic Government.

wars.name: First Balkan War (Albanian lands)
wars.outcome: Albania declared independence on 28 November 1912 during the war; its lands 'were occupied by the Balkan League member states' (Serbia, Montenegro, Greece) until the Great Powers recognised an Albanian principality on 29 July 1913.

wars.name: Albania in World War I
wars.outcome: Albania collapses after Prince Wilhelm leaves on 3 September 1914; by 11 November 1918 Italy held most of the country, Serbia the north, Greece a sliver and France Korçë and Shkodër; the Congress of Lushnjë (January 1920) and the Albanian rising force Italy…

wars.name: Battle of Vlora
wars.outcome: Albanian forces besiege Italian-occupied Vlorë; in September 1920 Rome abandons its claims and withdraws from all Albania except Sazan Island.

wars.name: Italian invasion of Albania
wars.outcome: Italian troops land on 7 April 1939; Zog flees on 9 April; on 12 April the parliament votes the union with Italy in personal union under Victor Emmanuel III.

wars.name: German occupation of Albania and the partisan war
wars.outcome: Germany occupies all of Albania in autumn 1943; the partisans liberate Tirana on 17 November 1944 and all Albania on 29 November 1944.

certainty.note: Only Vlorë was held; the borders were drawn by the Great Powers in July 1913 and not surveyed on these pages.
The 1913 borders are nominal; occupation lines of Italy, France, Serbia, Greece and the Central Powers are approximate.
The 1913 borders reaffirmed by a League of Nations commission.
Italian and German occupation; the Greater Albania lands (Kosovo) are approximate.
